title: Loner Life in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Bookish loner Haruka is transported to another world with his whole class but arrives last, after a god has handed out all the good cheat skills. Stuck with weak leftover abilities, he survives by wit while classmates split into cliques and the delinquents turn predatory. He ends up looking after the girls of his class as they face monsters and, later, kingdom politics and war.
life_message: It holds up self-reliance and quiet competence: a loner can still protect others by his own wits.
